technical.summary: AEP shows solid intermediate trend strength with price above key moving averages and bullish MACD crossovers, but overbought oscillators and weak short-term momentum indicators suggest caution on immediate entry timing.

fundamental.summary: AEP shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 62 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity neutral with only small sales by junior members; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide minimal offset; earnings in 62 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Intermediate trend strength (price above 200-EMA, supertrend bullish, MACD crossover up, new 10-day highs) combined with extreme fear sentiment (22/100) creates a contrarian accumulation opportunity for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), weak short-term momentum (failed EMA 9/21 and SMA 9/21 crosses, no AO confirmation), VIX crisis regime (367.2), and high earnings risk in 62 days with zero fundamental catalysts make immediate entry timing poor despite technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Intermediate trend strength (price above 200-EMA, supertrend bullish, MACD crossover) combined with extreme fear sentiment (22/100) offers contrarian appeal, but overbought oscillators and weak short-term momentum require better entry timing.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (367.2) combined with earnings event in 62 days and zero fundamental catalysts creates material downside risk if market volatility spikes or earnings disappoint.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents support entry; fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose due to macro environment and earnings proximity.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 16 Utilities positions and existing AEP position; sector concentration and ticker overlap warrant significant conviction reduction and minimal sizing if entry occurs.
